svg.title: B15 / Back of the tea house
svg.text: B15 / Back of the tea house
Two high blind panels articulate the retaining/enclosure screen beside the terrace, with E1 opening a tested overlook.
Source shells / roofs; rust = design extent, not a live transform.
Cut all blockers above2.50 in x10..11,y58..61. Keep1.10 m parapet
above Tea floor1.40 and tall flanks. Slot removes intersecting
roof fixtures. Existing shade at y62.4 must bear on retained north
flank. Baseline niches are excluded where slot cuts them. Test
Opening shapes are schematic; retained repaired frames are not redesigned. Source roof boxes are a static survey, not a live scene
or clearance pass. Dimensions and relationships: buildings.md; assemblies/export bounds: assets.md.
METRES / solid ink: retained grey dashed: current replaced envelope rust: proposal green: route
